# Text (`text`)

Type scale: jumbo to caption, mono eyebrows and section titles, tones.

Group: Foundations. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/foundations';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const header = document.createElement('header');
header.append(
  createText('Living room', { variant: 'eyebrow', tone: 'muted' }),
  createText('21.5°', { variant: 'display' }),
  createText('Heating to 22° until 23:00.'),
  createText('Window open', { variant: 'label', tone: 'warning' }),
);

document.body.append(header);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function TextExample() {
  return (
    <header>
      <Text variant="eyebrow" tone="muted">
        Living room
      </Text>
      <Text variant="display">21.5°</Text>
      <Text>Heating to 22° until 23:00.</Text>
```
